note:
Krugman articles about technology.
* misjudged the importance of internet (1998, said by 2005 be no more impactful than fax machine)
* correctly judged solars coming into prominence and it's falling cost in 2011 (7%/year)
* Correctly was skeptical about inflated housing prices from 2005-2006
* too bearish on digital publishing (2009 nyt, didn't understand subscription or other models)
* bearish on AI (2023 'shouldn’t have a large effect on economic projections for the next decade')
